  Details:
  ## Summary
  Recovered and shipped the AGL expense-processor (GAS project 19Wag9x) fix end-to-end, resolving an incident where a `clasp push` deleted the editor-only `Credentials.gs` and breaking deployments @HEAD/@8/@9.
  
  ## Work completed (thread 21628, 2026-09-06)
  1. **PR #459 (tokenomics, merged 08f8060)** — `fix(gas): authorize DAO-agent (autopilot) expense filings for governors`. Added `isAgentFilingForGovernor_` so expenses Sophia files for governor Gary Teh (registered agent) score `authorized` instead of `unauthorized`.
  2. **Deploy + recovery** — Pushed code via `clasp`; discovered my own push had deleted the live editor-only `Credentials.gs` (no `.claspignore` guard), breaking @HEAD/@9 with `ReferenceError: setApiKeys is not defined`. Reconstructed a **secret-free** `Credentials.js` (Script-Properties-read pattern + guarded no-op `setApiKeys()`), pushed it with the fixed Code.js, and created deployment v10.
  3. **Ledger cleanup + verified re-score** — Removed stale `unauthorized` scored rows (pix + USD dinner) so they'd re-score under the new rule; kept the superseded R$ dinner row as a dedup blocker. Fired v10 → pix (−19.37) booked once to AGL15 (row 61), USD dinner (−44.49) booked once to AGL16 (row 4), R$ original stayed `unauthorized` (no double-book). Verified dedup holds on re-fire (each hash scored exactly once; AGL15/16 row counts unchanged).
  4. **PR #460 (tokenomics, merged 5416bf5)** — `fix(gas): add .claspignore + Credentials.sample.js guard` so `clasp push` can never delete the live credential file again (same failure mode previously fixed for SunMint in PR #448).
  5. **PR #943 (agentic_ai_context, merged 101bdf7)** — Filed OPEN_FOLLOWUPS cleanup item: sibling GAS project 1wONDeDwZ has live Wix IST + Telegram secrets in a plaintext `Credentials.js` on shared disk — verify-not-committed + rotate + convert to secret-free pattern.
  6. **Canonical deployment repoint** — Repointed the canonical @7 deployment (`AKfycbwYBlFig…`, "governor's only global override" — the URL the scheduler/trigger calls) to v10 via `clasp redeploy`. Verified: fires clean (HTTP 200, "processed successfully"), no double-booking.
